research_topic: Improve continual learning forgetting resistance through intelligent task-ordering strategies on standard continual learning benchmarks (Split-CIFAR100 with 20 tasks, Permuted-MNIST with 20 tasks, Split-ImageNet with 15+ tasks) using 1-3B parameter models with parameter-efficient adaptation techniques, implementing curriculum learning frameworks based on task similarity metrics and gradient interference analysis, evaluated with rigorous statistical testing across 5+ random seeds against comprehensive baselines including random ordering, chronological ordering, similarity-based clustering, EWC, A-GEM, and PackNet, with mandatory ablation studies isolating each proposed component's contribution, quantified computational overhead analysis, stability gap measurement, forward/backward transfer evaluation, and complete reproducibility requirements including source code, detailed hyperparameters, and failure case analysis to demonstrate statistically significant improvements in final accuracy, average forgetting reduction, and deployment practicality.
